The close button in the Pasted Content panel no longer disappears on hover in dark mode. I haven't run the app or checked it in a browser.

In `src/lib/components/chat/UploadedFile.svelte` I added `dark:text-gray-400 dark:hover:text-gray-200`. The icon is now gray-400 at rest and brightens to gray-200 on hover in dark mode. Light mode is unchanged.
